sources.flexes: SHAFT_FLEX_DATA keys in mujoco_humanoid_golf/club_configurations.py (220-272 cpm, values and sources in src/config/shaft_flex_frequencies.json).
sources.tip_force_n: Unit transverse tip load; the response is linear (small deflection), so only the ratio to theory matters.
sources.gravity_m_s2: Standard gravity, applied transverse to the shaft with the head attached at the tip.
sources.tip_torque_n_m: 1 ft lbf, the load of the usual shaft torque-rating test (approximate, from memory).
sources.quadrature_points: Trapezoid grid for the Euler-Bernoulli gravity and Rayleigh integrals on the same linearly interpolated station EI; 801 points put every one of the 41 profile stations on a grid node and keep the quadrature error far below 1e-4.
sources.same_input_rk4_substeps: same_input/integrator.py DEFAULT_SUBSTEPS = 8 classical RK4 substeps, 0.125 ms.
sources.free_vibration_amplitude_m: Initial tip deflection for the free vibration: small (0.5 cm) so the linearised frequency applies.
sources.free_vibration_duration_s: 1 s of free vibration, as the task specifies for the energy check.
sources.static_rel_error_default_links: The R6 (#12686) acceptance level of the default 4-link chain against the FEM cantilever, now against independent Euler-Bernoulli quadrature, for deflection and slope.
sources.static_rel_error_finest_links: Midpoint lumping is second order, so 16 links should be within 0.1 % (16x below the 4-link level).
sources.flex_frequency_rel_error: The chain is calibrated to the flex cpm, so 3 % is a numerical bound on the calibration, not a flex-resolution claim; the flex steps are 10-14 cpm apart (4-6 %). The tolerance is unchanged by #15150 C19.
sources.rayleigh_rel_excess: Rayleigh's quotient with the static tip-load shape bounds the first frequency from above; for a tip-mass dominated shaft it is within a few percent of the exact value.
sources.time_domain_vs_eigen_rel_error: Zero-crossing frequency over 1 s of RK4 free vibration against the linearised eigenvalue: interpolated crossings resolve the period to well below 0.5 % at the 0.5 cm amplitude.
sources.rk4_amplification_max: Classical RK4 is stable for an eigenvalue lambda when |R(lambda h)| <= 1, R(z) = 1 + z + z^2/2 + z^3/6 + z^4/24.
sources.energy_drift_fraction: Undamped free vibration conserves energy; RK4 at a step far below the mode periods should keep the drift under 0.1 % over 1 s.
sources.torsion_rel_error_default_links: Same midpoint lumping as bending, so the same 1 % level against Saint-Venant theory on the same GJ(x).
sources.torque_rating_deg: Published driver shaft torque ratings span roughly 2.5-7 degrees under 1 ft lbf (approximate, from memory; tour shafts near 3, light senior and ladies shafts near 6-7).
